articles.title: Messi's Magic Runs Out, But Argentina Finds a New Hero!
articles.summary: Argentina was tied 1-1 against Switzerland and almost out of the World Cup—until Julián Alvarez blasted a rocket shot in extra time. They won 3-1 and will face England next. Messi didn't score for the first time in 10 games!

articles.title: England's Coach Is Grumpy Even Though They Keep Winning!
articles.summary: England beat Norway to reach the World Cup semifinals, but their coach Thomas Tuchel said he wasn't happy with how they played. He called them 'sloppy' and 'lucky.' Star player Jude Bellingham scored twice to save the day again.

articles.title: Ukraine's Prime Minister Steps Down—What's Going On?
articles.summary: Ukraine's Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko resigned on Sunday. President Zelenskyy said he offered her a new important job as part of a big government shake-up. This is the fourth major change since Russia's invasion started.
